# AutoRAG Architect v3.0 uses uv for dependency management.
# Dev dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml under [dependency-groups.dev].
#
# To install all groups:  cd backend && uv sync --all-groups
# To run tests:           uv run pytest
# To run linter:          uv run ruff check app
# To run type check:      uv run mypy app
#
# This file is retained only for tools that require its presence.
# The source of truth is pyproject.toml.
